cards.issue_title: Home footer Disclaimer reads like “we are not responsible”
summary_4_lines: The home-page footer Disclaimer sounds like Shroffin is washing its hands.
The rest of the site feels like “we are there for you,” but this block feels like “we are not responsible for anything.”
They still want it to say they are not the bank — just not in a cold legal-escape voice.
They compared it to a good lawyer: not the judge, but still standing with you.
cards.pinpoint: On the home page footer Disclaimer (expanded), they said the wording reads as Shroffin washing its hands — “we are not responsible” — which clashes with the rest of the site’s “we are there for customers” vibe; they still want the legal limit (not a bank / do not approve, sanction, underwrite, or disburse) but the tone should feel like standing with the customer.
cards.on_screen_object: Home footer region Disclaimer: summary paragraph plus expanded details behind “Read the full disclaimer”
quotes_sample: Overall, I feel that Shroffin's language is such that we are not responsible.
An entire vibe given by the disclaimer is how we are not responsible for anything.
The language shouldn't feel like legally doing away with obligations.
related_discussion_one_liners: Everyone writes disclaimers this way; asked whether Shroffin can sound different.

Drafted replacement while looking at the expanded text: still a third party / not the lender, then try a lot / work for the customer’s maximum benefit; a platform that standardizes third-party offerings into views customers can comprehend; try from data and interactions to show how banks may underwrite and disburse; not taking the bank’s responsibility but try to take responsibility; ultimately in the customer’s hands.
“Sometimes we say that we are very smart” three times — setup for the vibe contrast, not a separate control.
Good-lawyer analogy: a lawyer is not responsible for what the judge decides, but a good lawyer stands with you and inspires confidence.

Even if people do not understand, still put Shroffin’s own words in; then AI compatible / AI native / agent listening / emotions / camera as a writing-principle aside on the same Disclaimer (not a missing camera); closed the home-page pass (“Home run done. Time for a home page done.”).
